snip.t: Barbiturate use during status epilepticus in this syndrome is suspected to be associated with adverse outcomes; consequently, alternative acute therapies in such cases need to be considered.
Status epilepticus (SE) – a seizure lasting ≥5 min or recurrent seizures without full recovery of consciousness between episodes.
Failure of termination mechanisms (e.g., exhausted inhibitory interneurons) → prolonged seizure activity → status epilepticus.
Critical: Multi‑organ failure, shock, severe haemolysis, status epilepticus — Emergency resuscitation, multidisciplinary team, possible transfer to tertiary centre
